draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to the held-out customer-service domains (Insurance, Telecom and Utilities), where it achieves higher macro-F1 on each.
rationale: T1.r3–r5 show Wrenfold higher than Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains. The sentence hedges with "may" although the evidence supports an unqualified claim within the evaluated scope. No statistical test is reported, so significance language must be avoided, but the direction is directly supported.

judgement.proposition: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base extends to held-out customer-service domains
judgement.strongest_supported: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on all three held-out domains (Insurance 85.7 vs 81.2, Telecom 83.9 vs 80.4, Utilities 86.2 vs 82.0), so its advantage extends to customer-service domains not seen in training.
